raw_text: The Maldives government has signed a military cooperation agreement with China that includes provisions for joint exercises and a Chinese-funded coast guard training facility on Marao atoll, according to documents obtained by the Maldives Independent. The deal also provides for Chinese technical advisors to replace Indian military personnel who were asked to leave under the India Out campaign. The agreement was signed during Defence Minister Ghassan Maumoon's visit to Beijing last week.
clean_text: Maldives signed military deal with China for joint exercises and coast guard facility on Marao atoll. Chinese advisors replacing Indian personnel expelled under India Out campaign.
